Category: Very Expensive
Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee
Range: Melee

Every Aimed Shot deals 1d6 more (4d6), and on Aimed Shot damage 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. Each Critical Injury it lands also rolls 1d6 for an extra effect: 1, roll again until two different results above 1 come up and apply both; 2, the victim takes -3 MOVE (minimum 0) for 9 seconds (3 Rounds); 3, the victim is set Strongly on Fire (4 HP a turn); 4, the victim is knocked Prone and takes Cracked Skull even if the attack wasn't aimed at the head; 5, the victim takes -2 REF and DEX (minimum 0) for 9 seconds (3 Rounds) and can't dodge Ranged Attacks; 6, the user gets +5 on their next attack check with it. Under the Night City Tarot DLC, a Tarot from this weapon draws three cards and the user keeps one, the other two going back into the deck undrawn.

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
